timeline.evidenceText: “Yahweh, when you went out of Seir,
Then the earth shook and trembled.
Have you made him to leap as a locust?
Smoke went out of his nostrils.
There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad,
You have given a banner to those who fear you,
You, God, sent a plentiful rain.
Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land.
Your way was through the sea;
Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in Yahweh of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.
Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms,

It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.
The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan.
But Yahweh is the true God.
The earth trembles at the noise of their fall;
At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth trembles;
The land trembles and is in pain;

By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.
“The Lord Yahweh says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?

definitions.short: to undulate (as the earth, the sky, etc.; also a field of grain), particularly through fear; specifically, to spring (as a locust)

definitions.full: H7493. raash [ רָעַשׁ ] verb quake, shake , intransitive (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew, so Aramaic (rare), and (once) רְשְַׁ toss, rage (of sea); Arabic , usually , , (loan-word?), tremble, quiver, quake ; compare perhaps Assyrian rêšu , exult ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular רָעֲשָׁה Jer 8:16 ; 49:21 , רָעָ֑שָׁה Judg 5:4 ; Psa 68:9 ; 3 plural רָעֲשׁוּ Joel 2:10 +, etc. Imperfect 3masculine singular יִרְעַשׁ Psa 72:16 , 3 feminine plural תִּרְעַשְׁנָה Ezek 26:10 , etc.; Participle plural רֹעֲשִׁים Jer 4:24 ; — quake, shake , of earth Judg 5:4 = Psa 68:9 , 2Sam 22:8 (|| רגז ) = Psa 18:8 (|| id. ), 77:19 (+ רגז ), also Isa 13:13 (with עַלכֵּֿן , + מִמְּקוֺמוֺ , pregnantly; || רָגַז ), Jer 51:29 ; with מִן causative 8:16 ; 10:10 ; 49:21 ; of אָ֑רֶץ מוֺסְדֵי Isa 24:18 ; of heavens Joel 2:10 ( לִפְנֵי causative; || רָגַז ); heavens and earth Joel 4:16; mountains Jer 4:24 ; Nahum 1:5 ( מִן person causative ), Psa 46:4 ( ב causative ); walls Ezek 26:10 ( מִן causative ); אִיִּים 26:15 (id.); מִגְרשׁוֺת 27:28 ( ל causative ); הַסִּמִּים Amos 9:1 ; all living things Ezek 38:20 ( מִמָּנַי causative ); of waving grain Psa 72:16 . Niph`al הָאָרֶץ נִרְעֲשָׁה Jer 50:46 is made to quake ( מִקּוֺל ). Hiph`il Perfect 2masculine singular הִרְעַשְׁתָּה Psa 60:4 ; 1 singular הַרְעַשְׁתִּי Ezek 31:16 ; ׳וְהִר consecutive Hag 2:7 ; Imperfect 2masculine singular suffix 3 masculine singular (הֲ)תַרְעִישֶׁנּוּ Job 39:20 ; Participle מַרְעִישׁ Isa 14:16 2 t.; — 1 cause to quake , subject ׳י , with accusative of heavens, earth, nations, etc., Hag 2:6-7 , 21 , compare Psa 60:4 ; nations + מִקּוֺל Ezek 31:16 ; subject man, with accusative of kingdoms Isa 14:16 (|| מַרְגִּיז ). 2 cause (horse) to spring, leap (like locust), man subject, Job 39:20 .
